tagline: What's the smartest next move for you and your Toyota?
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
customer_id_hint: It's on your TFS statement, e.g. CUST-JAMES.
qr_hint: Have a QR code from TFS? Scan it with your phone camera to sign in.
guest_point_1: See where you stand: your vehicle, contract and key dates in one place.
guest_point_2: Get one clear next move, compared side by side with your other options.
guest_point_3: Understand why, with the numbers and assumptions behind it.
not_found: We couldn't find customer {id}. Check the ID and try again.
sit_lease_end_body: You have a few choices to make before your lease ends. We compared them for you.
sit_mileage_overage: You're on track to go over your miles
sit_mileage_overage_body: Extra miles can add fees at lease end. Some options avoid them.
sit_positive_equity: Your vehicle is worth more than you owe
sit_positive_equity_body: That equity can work for you, now is a good time to look at your options.
sit_rate_drop_body: A lower rate could reduce what you pay.
sit_early_payoff_body: Paying a little extra could save you interest.
sit_life_event_body: Your plan should fit your life. Let's check it still does.
sit_payment_stress_body: It happens. There are simple ways to get back on track, and a person can help.
sit_ev_switch: An electric Toyota could fit you
sit_ev_switch_body: Based on how you drive, switching could lower your costs.
sit_none_body: Nothing needs your attention today. We'll let you know if that changes.
no_alternatives: No other options to compare right now.
under_review: A specialist is reviewing your options. We'll be in touch shortly.
guardian_pass: Every number checked against TFS calculations
what_if_body: Move the sliders to see how your options change. TFS recalculates every number.
best_now: The best time to move is now
best_in: The best time to move is in {months} months
net_position_hint: Net position = equity minus fees for that month
act_now_vs_wait: Acting now instead of waiting 3 months:
true_cost_body: Everything you pay each month, plus the CO2 your driving produces.
act_send_packet_body: Send your “{option}” details and eligibility to a Toyota dealer, so they're ready when you arrive.
confirm_send_packet: Send your deal packet to the dealer now?
act_book_body: A TFS specialist calls you at a time that suits you.
act_self_service_body: Start “{option}” online, at your own pace.
self_service_started: Started. Next, finish it online or with your Toyota dealer.
offer_claimed: Offer claimed. It's saved to your account.
no_offers: No offers for you right now. We'll let you know when one comes up.
talk_to_person_body: A TFS specialist joins with your options already in front of them.
confirm_talk: Ask a specialist to join now?
handoff_waiting: Waiting for the next available specialist…
handoff_claimed: {who} is on the way to help you
live_offline: Live updates are offline. Your request was still sent.
hardship_body: Life changes. Here are your options, worked out from your account. Nothing changes until you choose.
hardship_yours: You can accept this one here.
hardship_specialist: A TFS specialist decides this. Request a callback.
due_date_accepted: Accepted: {option}. Request a callback and a TFS specialist makes it official.
request_callback_body: A TFS specialist calls you about a deferral or extension. Only they can approve those.
inspection_body: Take or choose a photo of each angle. We'll estimate any wear charges before your lease-end inspection.
angle_front_tip: Stand back so the whole bumper and hood fit.
angle_rear_tip: Include the bumper, trunk and taillights.
angle_left_tip: Capture both doors and both wheels on the driver's side.
angle_right_tip: Capture both doors and both wheels on the passenger side.
angle_wheels_tip: Get close to one wheel so the rim edge is clear.
camera_failed: We couldn't open the camera. Choose a photo instead.
ask_body: Ask about your options in your own words. Every number comes from TFS calculations.
ask_suggest_3: What happens if I do nothing?
voice_unsupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser. Type instead.
caption: Speaking
guardian_revise: Some checks need a second look: {checks}
showroom_alt: Stylized 3D model of a {car} in {color}, exploded {pct}%. Use the buttons on the model or in the panel to learn about each part.
price_na: Price not available for this trim
orbit_hint: Drag to orbit 360°, pinch or scroll to zoom.
reviews_none: No review summary available right now.
hs_hint: Tap a + on the model to see what each part does.
hs_body_body: The outer shell and glass. Lift it off with the exploded view to see what's inside.
hs_powertrain_body: The engine, plus the electric motor on hybrid models, which work together to move the car.
hs_battery_body: Stores energy recovered when braking and powers the electric motor. On gas models this space holds no battery.
hs_chassis_body: The frame, suspension and wheels that carry everything else.
hs_interior_body: Seats for five and the driver's controls.
attract_tap: Tap to see your next move
attract_sub: Lease ending? Payment trouble? Ready to upgrade? Get a clear answer in a minute.
continue_phone_body: Scan with your phone camera to pick up right here. Your session on this kiosk will reset on its own.
qr_alt: QR code that opens NextMove on your phone
slow_advisor: Getting a live answer. This can take up to 20 seconds.
slow_inspection: Live photo check. This takes about 10 seconds.
